comment: Fix anchor-write-guard missing 'git branch' as a write subcommand: 'git branch -f <name> <ref>' (e.g. force-moving a stale local main to match a rewritten origin/main) could force-move/delete/rename/copy a ref in the anchor undetected. Adds a precise exemption so a safe read-only invocation (listing, --show-current, etc.) still passes.
